prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line heritage architecture plate for 访古.
Image1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY: match its fine, elegant slightly organic contour strokes, generous white areas and restrained density. Image2 is the ACTUAL photograph of the Northern Song PILU / VAIROCANA HALL 游仙寺毗卢殿 at Youxian Temple, Gaoping, Shanxi. Preserve this specific hall's geometry, not another Buddhist hall.
Exactly THREE bays, SINGLE-EAVE XIESHAN hipped-gable roof, wide deep eaves, long low ridge carrying the photographed tiny center ridge ornament and end ornaments. Thick brick infill reaches the front eave column plane, so the facade reads as three openings between broad brick piers, NOT an open veranda with freestanding columns. Keep central FOUR-panel lattice door and its geometric lattice transom above, two rectangular side windows each divided into FOUR lattice panels with tall upper solid transom boards. Keep the actual visible timber lintels and one bracket set between each adjacent column position, as photographed. Roof pitch gentle, projecting eaves broad, short raised platform with one central stair of a few shallow steps. No added roof storey, side porch, pagoda, columns in front of wall or extra bays.
Use a nearly frontal facade view with just modest depth as in the photo, verticals upright and the complete roof silhouette shown. Remove neighbouring halls, all labels/signs/writing, sky, hills, modern fixtures and pavement texture. No invented restored sculpture or murals inside.
Sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE: thin contours, fine selective structural lines, ALL roof/wall/door/window/recess areas WHITE. The large roof plane must stay almost blank: at most12-16 widely spaced fine descending lines, no transverse tile seams and no repeated tile arcs. No brick courses across walls. Simplify window grids to readable open linework. No solid shadows, no gray, dense hatching, grain, texture, color, watermarks, letters, frame or labels. Landscape1536x1024, whole hall and stairs centered within82%canvaswidth, generous white margins, no cropping.
Image3 is our earlier generated draft and an EDIT TARGET ONLY. Keep its hall silhouette and structural arrangement. Change the lattice rendering: in ALL12 lower lattice panels (four in each side window, four in central door), REPLACE filled dark squares with OPEN WHITE small squares surrounded by hairline black grid. Reduce each narrow panel grid to just3columns by6rows. White square cells, never black dots or checkerboard. Render the upper geometric door transom as a sparse few outline motifs on white, not dense dark lace. Use thinner line weight throughout the fenestration. These are outline drawings of openings, not shadowed photographs. No other changes to roof shape, bay count, columns or stairs.

site_recommendation.name: 高平游仙寺
site_recommendation.era: 北宋淳化时期 · 毗卢殿
site_recommendation.yearNote: 地方文旅记述990，前殿未见同期创建题记，采用990—994时段约略定位，不冒认精确竣工年。
site_recommendation.place: 山西高平 · 河西镇宰李村牛山
site_recommendation.lede: 游仙寺毗卢殿把宽屋檐压在厚实墙身之上，三间门窗收得紧凑。檐下斗栱与自然弯材构架，保留了北宋前期地方匠作的做法。

facts.label: 淳化宋构
facts.text: 毗卢殿通常断于北宋淳化时期，金元以后屡修，寺内各殿并非同一年代。

facts.label: 厚墙深檐
facts.text: 三间六椽、单檐歇山，出檐深远，砖墙贴近檐柱平面，与前廊式佛殿外观不同。

facts.label: 弯材成构
facts.text: 丁栿用天然弯材加工，梁架保存地方匠作特点，另有元代维修题记。
